channel.title: Junaid Hussnain — Engineering Notes
channel.description: Practical notes on backend systems, open source, architecture, delivery, and engineering leadership.

item.title: Designing a Redacted Provenance Ledger for Laravel AI Agents
item.description: How to track which user, retrieval, tool, and application inputs entered an agent invocation without turning observability into a second store of sensitive content.

item.title: Backporting Meilisearch Dynamic Search Rules Without Dropping PHP 7.4
item.description: A field note on moving a modern Meilisearch PHP feature onto v1.x while preserving its public conventions, PHP 7.4 support, and a green integration suite.

item.title: Designing CI-Safe Evaluation Baselines for Laravel AI Agents
item.description: How to persist redacted security-evaluation baselines, preserve distinct failure categories, and emit safe GitHub Actions annotations from Laravel.

item.title: Building Big Software That Stays Small (from a PHP engineer's desk)
item.description: Learn how to design PHP systems that scale without complexity by using black-box modules, stable contracts, and careful interface design. Keep your large systems maintainable and team-friendly.

item.title: The Blazingly Fast Tech Stack to Power Your Next Million-Dollar Project
item.description: Choosing the right tech stack can make or break your million-dollar idea. Here’s the proven, blazingly fast stack I’d use to launch, scale, and win in today’s market.

item.title: When Leading Feels Lonely
item.description: Leadership can create a quiet kind of isolation. Here is how I learned to build support, boundaries, and honest peer connection on purpose.

item.title: Leading When You’re Not the Loudest in the Room
item.description: Leadership is not volume. A reflection on listening well, creating space, and building trust through steady, intentional presence.
